addressRetiresAt.description: After this time the deposit address is retired, and a deposit sent to it later never executes. One that Polyester records on this QuickSwap is listed in deposits as RETURN_ONLY (DEPOSIT_ADDRESS_RETIRED): it is returned to return_address when it can be, and its direct_return reports whether it was. One the network refuses before Polyester records it is not listed in deposits, and nothing on any QuickSwap reports it or its return; report its transaction to Polyester broker support with the swap_id. For an unfunded address it equals funding_expires_at. After a deposit is accepted it is provisional, a lower bound, until Polyester releases the deposit address, which can be shortly after the QuickSwap becomes terminal; from then on it is at least 7 days after all payouts finish. It only moves later, never earlier, and never before funding_expires_at.

A deposit can execute only if Polyester detects it before this time; detection time counts, not block time, and confirmations may finish later. A deposit detected at or after this time never executes; it is RETURN_ONLY, and so is a deposit observed after the address retired. For an unfunded address, address_retires_at equals this time, so there is no separate scheduled return period. Send deposits well before this time. Never changes.

The gas a plain transfer needs differs by network: several layer-2 networks and EVM forks do not use 21000. If the limit is too low, the transfer fails on chain without depositing, and the network fee is still charged. Zero for token deposits and non-EVM networks.

minDepositAmount.description: Published minimum deposit, in source token units, compared with the deposit before its network fee. Send at least this amount. It is never below the source network's minimum deposit (AssetChainVariant.deposit_min_amount in the config, for DepositInstructions.zipped_asset_id). A smaller deposit is returned to return_address (DEPOSIT_BELOW_MINIMUM) only if it reaches the source network's minimum deposit; a deposit below that minimum is not detected, recorded or returned, and is lost. For a bridge, min_deposit_amount often equals the source network's minimum deposit; when they are equal, any smaller deposit is lost. It differs from ErrorDetail.min_deposit_amount, the smallest deposit that currently quotes. For a TWAP it is the slice count times the smallest deposit one slice takes, and at least a market execution's minimum. The deposit network fee is charged on the actual deposit and can exceed the quoted one: a bridge deposit of at least this amount whose credit after that fee is below one base unit of the destination token is also not executed (DEPOSIT_BELOW_MINIMUM, see that reason for how its return ends).

minRate.description: Guaranteed minimum execution rate: destination display units per source display unit, as a decimal string with at most 18 fractional digits, rounded up when quoted. On a two-leg route, the source amount converted is the first leg's input in proportion to the intermediate funds the second leg converted. Source that is not traded is returned to return_address, and intermediate funds that the second leg does not convert are refunded in the intermediate asset to refund_address; those parts are outside the destination guarantee. The amount delivered is the output less the actual withdrawal network fee, which can differ from the quote.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.BIWEEKLY: Every two weeks on weekday at minute_of_day UTC: in the week of anchor_date and every second week before or after it.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DAILY: Once a day at minute_of_day UTC.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.HOURLY: Checked every hour at minute_of_hour UTC; pays only an asset whose payable amount has reached its minimums, so a payout follows within the hour of the balance reaching them. An hour with nothing to pay records no run.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MONTHLY: Once a month on day_of_month at minute_of_day UTC. A month without that day runs on its last day: day 31 runs on April 30 and on February 28 or 29, and days 29 and 30 run on the last day of February.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.WEEKLY: Once a week on weekday at minute_of_day UTC.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.NO_DESTINATION: Nothing would pay, and every positive balance is in an asset the rule has no destination for.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAUSED: The rule is paused, by a person or by itself (see pause); no run starts until it is resumed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ROLLS_OVER: Nothing would pay: every asset with a destination is below its minimum or the rule's USD minimum, has no current price for that minimum, or pays a broker vault's destination that is still cooling down. The balance stays on the account for a later run.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.WILL_PAY: At least one asset would pay.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ADD_DESTINATION: Adds the destination to the vault's allowlist.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.REMOVE_DESTINATION: Removes the destination from the vault's allowlist.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.LIMIT_REACHED: ADD_DESTINATION only: the allowlist already held 50 destinations on the destination's network when the change was applied.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.NOT_LISTED_ON_CHAIN: REMOVE_DESTINATION only: the destination was no longer on the allowlist when the change was applied.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.REFUSED: The change was refused for another reason.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.REQUESTER_NO_LONGER_ALLOWED: The requesting member no longer held the Owner or Finance role, under the same grant, when the change was applied.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TIMED_OUT: The change could not be applied before its expires_at.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.APPLIED: Applied: the destination is on the vault's allowlist (ADD_DESTINATION) or no longer on it (REMOVE_DESTINATION). An added destination is payable from its VaultAllowlistEntry.payable_from.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.NOT_APPLIED: Not applied, and never will be; failure says why. Nothing changed on the vault's allowlist. Request the change again to retry it.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PENDING: Accepted and being applied on chain. A vault has at most one pending change.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ADMIN: Everything except withdrawals, payout settings, changing the Owner and transferring ownership: only the Owner and Finance withdraw or change payout settings.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.AFFILIATE_MANAGER: Creates affiliate vaults and views balances.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FINANCE: Reads, and the payout settings and withdrawals of the broker's vaults: changes a vault's payout address allowlist (RequestVaultAllowlistChange), sets its payout rule (chain.withdraw.v1.AutoWithdrawService) and withdraws from it (chain.withdraw.v1.WithdrawService.CreateWalletTradingWithdraw), naming the vault as the subaccount_id. Manages no vaults, keys or members.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.OWNER: Everything, including withdrawals, payout settings and transferring ownership. Exactly one per broker.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ACTIVE: The address accepts the first eligible deposit.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.REFUND_MODE: Entered on the first confirmed deposit. Any further deposit is returned or held and never executes. Ends at address_retires_at. An address that expires unfunded goes from ACTIVE straight to RETIRED.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.RETIRED: The address is retired. A deposit sent to it is not processed automatically; it is handled only through support-assisted recovery, and recovery is not guaranteed.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ELIGIBLE: The eligible deposit that confirmed first. It consumed the QuickSwap and is the only deposit that can execute.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.EVALUATING: Detected; eligibility is being evaluated. A deposit can already be credited (credited_at) while it is evaluated.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ON_HOLD: Held for review; it neither executes nor returns until released. A deposit blocked by its risk screen (SOURCE_SCREENING_BLOCKED) keeps this disposition after Zipper's compliance team transferred its funds out (QuickSwap CLOSED).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.RETURN_ONLY: Not accepted: it is returned to return_address and never executes. A deposit found ineligible after it was credited, such as a late deposit (LATE_DEPOSIT), one below min_deposit_amount but at least the source network's minimum deposit (DEPOSIT_BELOW_MINIMUM) or above max_deposit_amount (DEPOSIT_ABOVE_MAXIMUM), or one of the wrong asset or network (WRONG_ASSET), keeps credited_at and is returned from its credit. One never credited, such as one that reached the address after its one eligible deposit (DEPOSIT_ADDRESS_ALREADY_USED) or after it retired (DEPOSIT_ADDRESS_RETIRED), is returned directly, and direct_return reports that return; RETURN_ONLY alone does not confirm that the return completed.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.RETURN_COMPLETED: The return reached return_address and is final on its network; tx_hash is its transaction. Terminal: the return never changes state again.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.RETURN_HELD: The return is held and is not sent automatically: it was not possible (for example no return address, or the funds are no longer at the deposit address), awaits review, or was settled with support's help. Review can release it, and it then becomes RETURN_PENDING. The broker contacts Polyester broker support with the swap_id.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.RETURN_PENDING: The return is queued or being sent. Its transaction may still be replaced, so none is reported yet.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ACCOUNTING_INCONSISTENCY: Recorded slice data is inconsistent; no slice amounts are fabricated.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PRECISION_UNAVAILABLE: The precision of one or more execution assets is unavailable, so slice amounts cannot be shown accurately. Aggregate amounts in those assets are unset; the others remain available.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ABOVE_MAXIMUM: The amount exceeded the market's maximum order size.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.BELOW_MINIMUM: The amount was below the market's minimum order size.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DEADLINE_REACHED: The execution deadline ended this slice.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.EXECUTION_ENDED: The execution ended before this slot was used.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY: Available liquidity did not fill the whole order at its protected price.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PROTECTION_NOT_MET: No order could satisfy the swap's price protection.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SLOT_MISSED: The slot ended before an order could be sent.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.EXECUTING: An order has been sent and the outcome is not final.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FAILED: No input traded because an order or its execution failed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PARTLY_TRADED: The slice traded some input but left an order partly unfilled or intermediate funds unconverted.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PLANNED: Scheduled; no order has been sent yet.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SKIPPED: No input traded because the slot was not used or no order could fill.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRADED: The slice traded its planned orders in full.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.AFFILIATE: Affiliate fee of one trading leg, one affiliate's bps of what the leg receives, credited to that affiliate vault. Each affiliate has one per leg; on a bridge one, on the credited amount, charged at payout.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.BROKER: Broker fee of one trading leg, the request's broker_bps of what the leg receives, credited to the broker's default vault. A two-leg route has one per leg; a bridge has one, on the credited amount, charged at payout.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DEPOSIT_NETWORK: Network fee withheld from the deposit before it is credited. A quote shows an estimate; the fee withheld is the network's fee when the deposit arrives; Deposit.network_fee reports the fee recorded.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.REFERRAL: Referral commission of one trading leg: the referral partner's commission_bps (ReferralPricing) of what the leg receives, credited to the partner. It comes out of the broker fee and adds nothing to what the end user pays. Only a request with a referral_code has one; it never appears with AFFILIATE fees. On a bridge one, on the credited amount, charged at payout.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.REFUND_NETWORK: Estimated network fee withheld from a REFUND of unconverted intermediate asset on the refund route (refund_zipped_asset_id). Contingent: charged only if intermediate funds are refunded.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.RETURN_NETWORK: Estimated network fee withheld from a RETURN of untraded source funds on the source route. Contingent: charged only if funds are returned.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SERVICE: Service fee of one trading leg, credited to Polyester, in basis points of what the leg receives: the leg's pair fee, capped by any fee ceiling agreed with the broker. A two-leg route has one per leg. On a bridge, the one bridge fee, capped the same way, in basis points of the credited amount, charged at payout.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.WITHDRAWAL_NETWORK: Estimated network fee for a withdrawal. The actual fee is charged at withdrawal time and reported on the withdrawal.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.BY_DAY: By UTC day the fee was charged.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.BY_MONTH: By UTC month the fee was charged.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.CLOSE_PAID: The withdrawal completed on its destination network; the destination received amount minus charged_network_fee.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CLOSE_REFUNDED_TO_SMART_ACCOUNT: The destination network's bridge rejected the withdrawal and refunded its net, less the network fee it kept, to the vault's own smart account; a PAYOUT_REFUND entry and PayoutStep.refunded_amount show the refund. The debit stands.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CLOSE_SENT_TO_RECOVERY: The withdrawal's execution failed on its destination network: the net went to the bridge's recovery address, which settles it with the broker, and the network fee was kept. The debit stands.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CLOSE_UNKNOWN: The withdrawal failed, and where its funds went is not known: the payout ended before payouts recorded how a failed withdrawal closed, its outcome was not known when it ended, or the records of its end disagree. The payout may have left the vault or may have been returned to it; the vault's balance is authoritative.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.STAGE_BROADCAST: A destination-network transaction is known (PayoutStep.tx_hash); the run waits for its withdrawals to complete.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.STAGE_CONVERTING: The run is converting the vault's other assets into the rule's payout asset (Payout.conversions); its payout step is planned once every conversion is over and settled.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.STAGE_PLANNING: Reading the vault's balances to size the payouts.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.STAGE_PROCESSING: Every payout due was accepted; no destination-network transaction is known yet.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.STAGE_REQUESTING: A payout is waiting to be requested or being requested.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAYOUT_FAILED: Nothing was paid, and at least one asset's payout failed; reason is the first failure's: withdrawal_refused (refused before any funds left the vault), gateway_capacity_insufficient (the funds stay for a later run), withdrawal_released (released before it was sent; nothing left the vault) or withdrawal_failed (the withdrawal ended without paying, before or after it reached the destination network). Each step's close (PayoutStep.close, as ListVaultLedger shows it) says where the funds of a withdrawal that left the vault went; a withdrawal_failed step whose close was not recorded reads CLOSE_UNKNOWN, never a guess. The step's tx_hash, when set, is its destination-network transaction.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAYOUT_HELD: Nothing was paid because the rule stopped paying, and the balance stays in the vault. reason is rule_superseded (the rule was paused, changed or replaced before the run paid), or destination_not_whitelisted, destination_invalid or authority_revoked, with which the rule paused itself (see VaultPayoutRule.pause); an Owner or Finance member resumes it.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAYOUT_IN_PROGRESS: The run is under way; stage says where.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAYOUT_PAID: The run paid: every asset with a payable amount was withdrawn and its withdrawal completed on its destination network.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAYOUT_PARTIALLY_PAID: Some assets were paid and at least one failed; reason is the first failed asset's, and each step shows its own outcome.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAYOUT_ROLLED_OVER: Nothing was paid, and the balance stays in the vault for the next run. reason is nothing_to_pay (no asset reached its minimum), below_minimum (an amount was below the least a withdrawal on its network pays), price_unavailable (the rule has a USD minimum and no current price valued an asset), destination_cooling_down (the destination was added to the vault's external withdraw whitelist less than 24 hours ago), route_suspended (withdrawals to the destination's network were suspended) or supply_unavailable (the destination route's zToken supply was not known or not current). Each step carries the balance evaluated, its value and the minimum it was held to.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAYOUT_STEP_COMPLETED: The withdrawal completed on its destination network.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAYOUT_STEP_FAILED: The payout failed; reason says why (see PAYOUT_FAILED).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAYOUT_STEP_SKIPPED: Nothing was paid for this asset in this run; reason says why, and the balance stays in the vault.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAYOUT_STEP_SUBMITTED: The withdrawal was accepted and waits to complete on its destination network.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.CAPACITY_UNAVAILABLE: The deposit arrived and is safe, but processing capacity is temporarily unavailable. Processing resumes automatically when capacity frees up; no action is needed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DEPOSIT_ABOVE_MAXIMUM: The deposit is above max_deposit_amount, or above the largest order the route's market accepts. It is not executed: it is returned to return_address, and the QuickSwap shows RETURNING and RETURNED with this reason.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DEPOSIT_ADDRESS_ALREADY_USED: The address already accepted its one eligible deposit; this deposit is returned to return_address and never executes.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DEPOSIT_ADDRESS_CONFLICT: The QuickSwap could not be issued a deposit address and never gets one: it is EXPIRED without deposit_instructions, and nothing can be deposited to it. Create a new QuickSwap with a new idempotency key, and report the swap_id to Polyester broker support.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DEPOSIT_ADDRESS_NOT_ISSUED: The address had not been issued when this deposit was observed; it never executes.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DEPOSIT_ADDRESS_RETIRED: The address was retired when this deposit was observed. The deposit is RETURN_ONLY: it never executes and is returned directly to return_address when it can be; direct_return reports the return.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DEPOSIT_BELOW_MINIMUM: The deposit is below the published min_deposit_amount, or its credit after the deposit network fee is below the smallest order the route's market accepts or, for a bridge, below one base unit of the destination token. It is not executed: it is returned to return_address, and the QuickSwap shows RETURNING and RETURNED with this reason. When that return is below the withdrawal minimum of its asset and network, no withdrawal is made: the QuickSwap ends RETURNED with REFUND_BELOW_MINIMUM, its return withdrawal NOT_SENT, and the deposit keeps this reason. Only a deposit that reaches the source network's minimum deposit (AssetChainVariant.deposit_min_amount) is returned; one below it is not detected and never appears on the QuickSwap. A deposit that cannot be returned on the network it was received on is held (HELD with this reason); the broker contacts Polyester broker support with the swap_id.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.EXECUTION_DEADLINE_REACHED: The execution deadline passed before all input executed; untraded funds are refunded or returned. Shown while EXECUTING once the deadline ended trading, and on the payout statuses that follow.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FUNDING_WINDOW_ENDED: The funding window ended without an eligible deposit.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY: Available liquidity did not fill an order at its protected price; untraded input or intermediate funds are returned or refunded. Shown on the payout statuses that follow, including COMPLETED when a partly traded swap refunded the rest. A trade failure reason (this one or ORDER_REJECTED) is used only when the execution ended without another reason, such as EXECUTION_DEADLINE_REACHED or PROTECTION_NOT_MET; it is then the first slice in schedule order whose reason or carry_reason is INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY or ORDER_REJECTED, the reason before the carry_reason within a slice.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INTERMEDIATE_BELOW_MINIMUM: On a two-leg route, intermediate funds were below the smallest order the second leg's market accepts, so they could not be converted to the destination asset; they are refunded to refund_address. Shown on the payout statuses that follow.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.LATE_DEPOSIT: The deposit was first seen after funding_expires_at.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MARKET_CLOSED: A market on the route was halted, restricted or delisted when the deposit was credited and did not reopen within a bounded wait after the deposit was credited, the same for market and TWAP execution. Nothing was traded: the deposit is returned to return_address, and the QuickSwap shows RETURNING and RETURNED with this reason.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ORDER_REJECTED: An order was refused; untraded input or intermediate funds are returned or refunded. Shown on the payout statuses that follow, chosen as for INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.OUTCOME_RECONCILING: A processing step is being confirmed. Processing resumes automatically; no action is needed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PROTECTION_NOT_MET: Execution could not meet the protection; untraded funds are refunded or returned. When no protected order could be placed for the deposit, nothing is traded: the deposit is returned to return_address, and the QuickSwap shows RETURNING and RETURNED with this reason.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.REFUND_BELOW_MINIMUM: Refund not possible: an amount left to refund or return was below the withdrawal minimum of its asset and network, so no withdrawal was made for it. Its withdrawal is NOT_SENT with the amount in unsent_amount. Other withdrawals are unaffected.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SOURCE_SCREENING_BLOCKED: Polyester's deposit screening blocked the deposit. It is held for compliance review (HELD); it is never executed or returned automatically. The broker contacts Polyester broker support with the swap_id. If Zipper's compliance team later transfers the funds out to an address of its choosing, not necessarily the user's, the QuickSwap ends CLOSED with this reason; the funds were not returned to return_address.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SOURCE_SCREENING_FAILED: The deposit's risk screen failed with a return verdict; the deposit is not accepted and is returned to return_address.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SOURCE_WALLET_SCREENING_FAILED: The source wallet supplied in the request failed risk screening. The QuickSwap is REJECTED: it never gets a deposit address, and nothing can be deposited to it.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.WITHDRAWAL_FAILED: A withdrawal cannot be completed and is held for review. The broker contacts Polyester broker support with the swap_id.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.WRONG_ASSET: The deposit is not the quoted source asset or network. It is not executed: it is returned to return_address on the network and in the asset it was received in, and the QuickSwap shows RETURNING and RETURNED with this reason. A deposit that cannot be returned there, such as one received on a network where return_address is not valid, is held (HELD with this reason); the broker contacts Polyester broker support with the swap_id.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ALLOCATING: The quote is fixed and the deposit address is being allocated. After ADDRESS_UNAVAILABLE, allocation continues automatically until an address frees up; the wait has no fixed bound.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.AWAITING_DEPOSIT: Quote and deposit address allocated; waiting for the first eligible deposit before funding_expires_at.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CLOSED: Terminal: the deposit was blocked by its risk screen (SOURCE_SCREENING_BLOCKED), and Zipper's compliance team transferred the funds out on the deposit's network to an address of its choosing, not necessarily the user's. Nothing was returned to return_address or refunded. Its one withdrawal is that COMPLIANCE_TRANSFER, FINALIZED.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.COMPLETED: Terminal: every withdrawal is final (FINALIZED or NOT_SENT) and at least one is a DESTINATION withdrawal. A DESTINATION withdrawal is never NOT_SENT.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CONFIRMING: Waiting for source confirmations and deposit validation before credit.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CREDITED: The deposit is credited; execution is starting.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.EXECUTING: The credited deposit is being traded.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.EXPIRED: Terminal: the funding window ended without an eligible deposit (FUNDING_WINDOW_ENDED), or the QuickSwap never got a deposit address (DEPOSIT_ADDRESS_CONFLICT). With FUNDING_WINDOW_ENDED, terminal_at is funding_expires_at, also after a dropped or replaced deposit. If such a deposit confirms after all, its funds are held for review: the QuickSwap becomes HELD, with that deposit ON_HOLD, the one change of a terminal status.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.HELD: Funds are held for review. Not terminal: review resumes the QuickSwap or returns the funds, or, for SOURCE_SCREENING_BLOCKED, the QuickSwap can end CLOSED. reason says why when a specific reason applies, else it is REASON_UNSPECIFIED. The broker contacts Polyester broker support with the swap_id.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAYING_OUT: Execution finished with destination output; withdrawals, including any partial refund or return, are in progress.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PREPARING_DEPOSIT: The deposit is being prepared for credit. Retries keep this status.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.REFUNDED: Terminal: every withdrawal is final, none is DESTINATION, and at least one is REFUND (FINALIZED or NOT_SENT).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.REFUNDING: A two-leg route produced no destination output; the intermediate asset is being refunded to refund_address.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.REJECTED: Terminal: the source wallet supplied in the request failed risk screening (SOURCE_WALLET_SCREENING_FAILED). The QuickSwap never gets a deposit address, and every repeat of its create request returns SOURCE_WALLET_REJECTED with its swap_id.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.RETURNED: Terminal: every withdrawal is final and all are RETURN (FINALIZED or NOT_SENT).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.RETURNING: Nothing was traded or the deposit was not accepted; the source funds are being returned to return_address.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.WAITING_FOR_CAPACITY: An eligible deposit arrived and is safe; waiting for processing capacity. Processing resumes automatically when capacity frees up; the wait has no fixed bound.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.DESTINATION_AMOUNT: amount is the destination amount the end user wants to receive after fees, in destination token units. The quote reports the deposit amount needed at the quoted price. The delivered amount still follows the actual deposit and execution, bounded below by the protection.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SOURCE_AMOUNT: amount is the source amount the end user intends to deposit, in source token units.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ROUTE: By route: source and destination asset and network.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.VAULT: By the vault the QuickSwaps credited a broker or affiliate fee to. A QuickSwap that credited several vaults counts in each, so vault groups overlap.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.DAY: A UTC day. The window is at most 366 days long.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.HOUR: A UTC hour. The window is at most 7 days long.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MONTH: A UTC calendar month. The window is at most 3660 days long, so one request covers a broker's whole history.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.FEE_CREDIT: A broker or affiliate fee a QuickSwap credited to the vault, or a referral commission credited to a referral partner's earnings sub-account.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAYOUT_DEBIT: An asset's payout in a payout run, debited from the vault.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAYOUT_REFUND: The net of a payout the destination network's bridge rejected, refunded to the vault's own smart account, less the network fee it kept. The funds stay in that smart account: the refund is not part of the vault balance ListVaultBalances reads, and no entry returns it to the vault. A referral partner's earnings sub-account is refunded the same way.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.VAULT_ACTIVE: New QuickSwaps can credit the vault.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.VAULT_DISABLED: New QuickSwaps naming the vault are refused with AFFILIATE_VAULT_UNKNOWN. QuickSwaps already created still credit it.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.COMPLIANCE_TRANSFER: A deposit blocked by its risk screen (SOURCE_SCREENING_BLOCKED) that Zipper's compliance team transferred out on the network it was received on, to an address of its choosing, not necessarily the user's. Not a return or a refund: Polyester records neither the recipient nor the amount, so address, memo, amount and network_fee are unset; tx_hash is the transfer, and flow_id the deposit's flow.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DESTINATION: Swap output to destination_address on the destination network.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.REFUND: Untraded intermediate asset of a two-leg route, including a partial refund, to refund_address on the refund route's network.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.RETURN: Source funds that were not accepted or not traded, to return_address on the network and in the asset they were received in: the source network, or for a wrong asset the network it was sent on.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.FAILED: Definitively failed. The QuickSwap is HELD (WITHDRAWAL_FAILED); the broker contacts Polyester broker support with the swap_id.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.NOT_SENT: Final: no transaction was or will be made for this withdrawal, because its amount was below the withdrawal minimum of its asset and network (REFUND_BELOW_MINIMUM); unsent_amount is that amount.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.QUEUED: Approved and waiting to be submitted.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SUBMITTED: Submitted to the recipient's network; not yet final.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.EXPIRED: The execution window ended before the order could be placed, or a TWAP's deadline ended it with slots left untraded.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE: The Trading balance did not cover the amount when the order was placed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INTERMEDIATE_BELOW_MINIMUM: On a two-leg route, intermediate asset below the second market's minimum order, with later slices' intermediate added where a TWAP had slices left, stays on the account, unconverted (intermediate_remainder_e18).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MARKET_UNAVAILABLE: The market was closed, halted, restricted or without liquidity.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MAX_ORDER_QUANTITY: The order bought the market's maximum order quantity and stopped there; the rest of the amount stays on the account, unspent. The market's depth or maximum changed after the quote, which never quotes past it.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MINIMUM_NOT_MET: A fill netted less than the accepted minimum rate. The Swap failed closed: the amounts show exactly what was traded and received.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ORDER_REJECTED: The order was refused, for example by the sub-account's trading policy.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ORDER_SIZE_OUT_OF_RANGE: The order was outside the market's size limits.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PRICE_PROTECTION: The order books could not fill the rest at a price that meets min_amount_out.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.RATE_LIMITED: The account's order rate limit was reached.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.USER_CANCELED: The Swap's owner canceled it (CancelSwap) before its whole amount traded.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.CANCELED: The Swap's owner canceled it (CancelSwap) before its whole amount traded. The amounts show exactly what traded and settled; the unspent amount and any intermediate_remainder_e18 stay on the account. reason is USER_CANCELED.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CANCELING: The Swap's owner canceled it (CancelSwap) and the cancel is taking effect: no new slice or first-leg order is sent. An order already sent finishes, and a slice whose first leg traded still sends its second leg. The Swap then becomes terminal: CANCELED, or the outcome it would have had when the cancel came too late to stop anything. This usually takes seconds. While an order's outcome is being confirmed the Swap is RECONCILING instead, and CANCELING again once it is, until it ends.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.COMPLETED: The whole amount was traded and settled (a remainder smaller than one order step stays on the account, unspent).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.EXECUTING: The Swap is accepted and its orders are being placed, filled or settled.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FAILED: Nothing was traded and the whole amount stays on the account, or, with reason MINIMUM_NOT_MET, a fill netted less than the accepted minimum rate; reason says why, and the amounts show what was traded.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PARTIALLY_COMPLETED: Part of the amount was traded and settled; the rest stays on the account, unspent. reason says why.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.RECONCILING: An order's outcome is being established. Balances already reflect any settled fill; the Swap stays here until the outcome is confirmed. A canceled Swap shows RECONCILING too while it waits for such an outcome (see CancelSwap).

ApiKeyIdAuth.description: ID of the API key that signs the request. An API-key request sends it with X-API-TIMESTAMP and X-API-SIGNATURE.
ApiKeyIdAuth.name: X-API-KEY-ID

ApiKeySignatureAuth.description: Ed25519 signature of the request, made with the API key's private key and encoded as hex or base64. An API-key request sends it with X-API-KEY-ID and X-API-TIMESTAMP.
ApiKeySignatureAuth.name: X-API-SIGNATURE

ApiKeyTimestampAuth.description: Time the request was signed, in Unix milliseconds. An API-key request sends it with X-API-KEY-ID and X-API-SIGNATURE.
ApiKeyTimestampAuth.name: X-API-TIMESTAMP

BrokerApiKeyAuth.description: Broker API key, sent as a bearer token and accepted only by the QuickSwap broker API. The broker API key is a server credential. Call this API from the broker's backend, never from a browser or mobile app. The broker's members create, rotate and revoke keys through the QuickSwap broker API, and a key may rotate itself.

Public trading API for market makers and integrators.

get.description: Get the broker, its limits and current usage, and the caller's role.

parameters.description: Broker name.
parameters.name: broker

400.description: INVALID_ARGUMENT: malformed request.

401.description: UNAUTHENTICATED: missing or invalid broker API key or session token.

404.description: BROKER_NOT_FOUND: no such broker, or the caller is not a member of it, or a broker API key named another broker.

429.description: BROKER_LIMIT: the API key exceeded its request rate; retry after the Retry-After header's seconds.

500.description: INTERNAL: an internal error; the outcome is unknown, retry the same request.

503.description: UNAVAILABLE or DEADLINE_EXCEEDED: the outcome is unknown; retry the same request.

parameters.description: Broker name.
parameters.name: broker

parameters.description: End of the window, an RFC 3339 time, exclusive, at most 366 days after startTime.
parameters.name: endTime

parameters.description: How to group the totals.
